system_description.narrative_title: Escalating U.S.–Iran confrontation disrupting energy, tech, and regional security
system_description.narrative_summary: A rapidly intensifying U.S.–Iran confrontation—combining maritime strikes, missile development, and emergent uses of AI and foreign support—is destabilizing the Gulf and threatening global energy flows. Gulf states, private firms, and militaries are adapting infrastructure and commercial plans while sanctions, domestic U.S. politics, and great-power ties shape the conflict's trajectory.
system_description.scope: Military and proxy confrontations between the U.S. and Iran (maritime incidents, strikes, missile production), impacts on oil, gas, and shipping flows, sanctions and economic countermeasures, use and proliferation of dual-use technologies (AI, satellite imagery, missile tech), regional state and private-sector resilience/adaptations (UAE, Dubai infrastructure, crypto), and related domestic political dynamics in the U.S. and Iran.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-security-energy-technology system (interconnected international politics, global energy markets, and dual-use technological competition).
adjacent_subsystems: Global energy markets and supply chains (oil, shipping, fuel storage)
Gulf regional security and state resilience (UAE, Israel, Iraq, proxies, infrastructure protection)
Global tech and AI governance / dual-use technology proliferation
Defense-industrial base and strategic weapons development

variables.name: Military engagement intensity
variables.description: Measures the frequency and severity of kinetic confrontations and direct strikes between opposing armed forces and naval units.

variables.name: Maritime incident rate
variables.description: Measures the rate of disruptive incidents at sea affecting commercial shipping and naval operations (e.g., seizures, attacks, collisions).

variables.name: Oil & gas flow volume
variables.description: Measures the volume of oil and natural gas physically transiting regional export routes and chokepoints over time.

variables.name: Energy infrastructure damage level
variables.description: Measures the cumulative extent of physical damage and functional degradation to energy infrastructure such as terminals, refineries, pipelines, and tankers.

variables.name: Missile production rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which guided and ballistic missile systems and key components are produced and deployed.

variables.name: Dual-use technology diffusion
variables.description: Measures the spread and availability of dual-use technologies (AI tools, high-resolution imagery, critical components) across actors in the region.

variables.name: Sanctions enforcement intensity
variables.description: Measures the scope, strictness, and operational rigor of economic and financial restrictions applied against target actors and networks.

variables.name: Financial reserve level
variables.description: Measures available liquid financial buffers and accessible external assets that can be used to stabilize an economy under stress.

variables.name: Energy price volatility
variables.description: Measures short- to medium-term fluctuations in global and regional oil and gas prices driven by supply, demand, and risk perceptions.

variables.name: Shipping insurance premiums
variables.description: Measures the cost level and risk surcharges charged to insure maritime shipments transiting the relevant region.

variables.name: Commercial adaptation rate
variables.description: Measures the speed and extent of private-sector adjustments such as rerouting, storage investment, and operational changes in response to risks.

variables.name: Diplomatic engagement intensity
variables.description: Measures the level and frequency of diplomatic communications, negotiations, and mediation efforts among relevant actors.

variables.name: Proxy force activity level
variables.description: Measures the operational tempo and scope of non-state proxy operations and attacks linked to competing state actors.

variables.name: Defense technology development rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which defensive technologies and countermeasures (e.g., missile defenses, jamming, AI detection) are developed and fielded.

variables.name: Supply chain disruption level
variables.description: Measures the degree of interruption to logistics and supply chains for energy and critical technological components.

variables.name: Domestic political pressure
variables.description: Measures the intensity of internal political and public pressure on policymakers that influences strategic and economic decisions.

catalysts.title: Continued U.S. strikes on Iranian-linked vessels
catalysts.description: Ongoing U.S. strikes and counterstrikes at sea targeting Iranian oil tankers and related vessels, likely to continue in the near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: U.S. strikes Iranian oil tankers; close calls on U.S. warships indicate continued maritime action.

catalysts.title: Iran missile production ramp-up
catalysts.description: Iran accelerates production and deployment of ballistic and supersonic cruise missiles, reportedly with external assistance.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: Russia aiding supersonic cruise missiles; Iran producing ballistic missiles again.

catalysts.title: Dual-use AI and imagery diffusion to Iran and proxies
catalysts.description: Continued acquisition and operational use of foreign AI models and high-resolution imagery by Iran and proxies, improving targeting capabilities.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: Anthropic says Iran used U.S. AI model; U.S. links Chinese imagery to Iranian strike; UAE revises AI plans.

catalysts.title: Expanded sanctions and enforcement against Iran networks
catalysts.description: Continued U.S. roll-out of sanctions and operational enforcement against networks aiding Iran and its proxies.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: U.S. slaps new sanctions on networks aiding Iran's proxies; ongoing enforcement expected.

catalysts.title: Gulf infrastructure and data-center adaptations
catalysts.description: UAE/Dubai implement protective fuel storage and revise AI data-center plans to reduce strike and data-risk vulnerabilities.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: Dubai plans underground fuel tanks; UAE revises AI data center plans after Iranian attacks.

catalysts.title: Delayed recovery of regional oil flows
catalysts.description: Escalation keeps regional oil and gas exports below pre-conflict levels, delaying full flow recovery into next year.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: IEA/WSJ says U.S.-Iran escalation will delay oil flow recovery into next year.

catalysts.title: Shalamcheh border crossing closure
catalysts.description: Iraq's ordered closure of the Shalamcheh crossing cuts cross-border transit and disrupts regional logistics while in effect.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: Iraq orders closure of Shalamcheh border crossing with Iran, reducing transit.

catalysts.title: Surge in proxy force operations
catalysts.description: Iran-linked proxy groups increase attacks and operational tempo across the region in response to strikes and sanctions.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: U.S. sanctions on proxy networks; Israel-Hezbollah action and close naval calls suggest proxy escalation.

catalysts.title: U.S. midterm elections and possible policy shift
catalysts.description: 2026 U.S. midterm elections may prompt policy reassessments that could alter engagement tempo or de-escalation timing.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: Trump predicts war ending soon after midterms; advisers debate war duration, implying election-driven policy change.
